items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against refusal of Sondernutzungserlaubnis
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, an das Bezirksamt Musterwerder, Wasserturmweg 3, 22089 Hamburg zu richten, und zwar schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026; letter states it is deemed delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after Aufgabe zur Post, counting the posting day as day 0: 20.11 (1), 21.11 (2), 22.11 (3), 23.11.2026 (4, Monday) → deemed delivery = 23.11.2026 (not a weekend/holiday, so no fiction-shift rule applies). Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruch period begins the day after the triggering event, i.e. 24.11.2026, and per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a monthly period ends with the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering (bekanntgabe) day, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is a weekday and not a public holiday in Hamburg, so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed.

warnings: The due date assumes the letter was actually handed to the postal service (Aufgabe zur Post) on its printed date, 19.11.2026; if the authority posted it later, the one-month deadline shifts accordingly.
The letter mentions a possible alternative application for a single table against the house wall, but gives no deadline for this optional, informal request, so no item was created for it.
